title: Swift/Rust version provenance and desktop/iOS alignment target

ios.resolved_version_note: SwiftPM normalizes CalVer 26.06.06 to resolved version string 26.6.6

embedded_matrix_rust_sdk.proof_summary: Package bump commit message and GitHub release body both publish embedded commit 1c44fb66…; release tooling records git commitHash; matrix-sdk-0.18.0 annotated tag peels to the same commit.

comparison.packaging_note: iOS uses matrix-rust-components-swift UniFFI XCFramework; desktop embeds matrix-sdk/matrix-sdk-ui crates directly. Intentional full-replacement architecture, not dual-backend.
comparison.approximate_lag: Swift CalVer 26.06.06 published ~4 days after Rust release commit 1c44fb66

element_x_ios_reference.note: Context only; P0.4 does not bump iOS package versions.

decision_labels.D: deferred iOS bump with shared semantic fixtures as interim parity method

alignment.desktop_pin_policy: Remain on matrix-sdk/matrix-sdk-ui =0.18.0 at commit 1c44fb66214667c6d00acaf72ab592493653708b for Phase 1+ unless a later program-approved crate bump.
alignment.ios_pin_policy: Remain on matrix-rust-components-swift 26.06.06 (resolved 26.6.6 / ec3b2161…) until a separate approved iOS package upgrade task; do not follow Element X 26.07.15 in this task.
rationale: Primary-source evidence proves iOS 26.06.06 embeds matrix-rust-sdk commit 1c44fb66…, which is exactly matrix-sdk-0.18.0 and the locked desktop pin.
Program alignment is source-revision and protocol/behavior parity, not sharing the same FFI package: desktop embeds crates; iOS uses Swift FFI components.
No iOS bump and no desktop pin change in P0.4 preserves proven exact-commit alignment during Phase 0/1 foundation work.
If a future iOS CalVer bump moves ahead of desktop 0.18.0, re-run provenance and reclassify; use shared semantic fixtures as interim cross-platform parity method until pins reconverge.

residual_risks.risk: Future iOS CalVer bump may embed a newer Rust commit than desktop 0.18.0
residual_risks.mitigation: Re-run provenance before accepting any iOS components bump; decide desktop crate bump vs intentional temporary divergence

residual_risks.risk: Element X / ecosystem pressure to adopt 26.07.x+ bindings
residual_risks.mitigation: Treat as context only until a scoped iOS upgrade task with binding-diff review

residual_risks.risk: UniFFI surface vs crates public API remain distinct integration layers even at the same commit
residual_risks.mitigation: Same source commit minimizes semantic drift; cutover tests must exercise each platform binding surface

residual_risks.risk: XCFramework binary not byte-inspected in this task
residual_risks.mitigation: Package.swift checksum matches GitHub release asset digest; primary proof is published commit SHA in release metadata

follow_up_gates.gate: Keep desktop crates =0.18.0 until program-approved crate bump
Keep iOS components-swift 26.06.06 until approved iOS package upgrade task
Prefer shared semantic fixtures for cross-platform parity if packaging pins ever diverge

evidence.method: git log -1 / GitHub commits API on ec3b2161ba371a13609e7181077d2f3baef188f5

Upstream release tooling embeds git commitHash into the package bump commit message

evidence.claim: matrix-sdk-0.18.0 annotated tag peels to the same commit
evidence.method: GitHub git refs/tags API + annotated tag object

evidence.claim: Desktop P0.3a pin matches embedded commit
Local iOS Package.resolved revision matches upstream tag commit

validation_commands: git clone --depth 1 --branch 26.06.06 https://github.com/matrix-org/matrix-rust-components-swift components-swift && cd components-swift && git rev-parse HEAD && git log -1 --format=%B
curl -sL https://api.github.com/repos/matrix-org/matrix-rust-components-swift/releases/tags/26.06.06 | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d['body']); print(d['published_at'])"
git clone --depth 1 --branch matrix-sdk-0.18.0 https://github.com/matrix-org/matrix-rust-sdk matrix-rust-sdk && cd matrix-rust-sdk && git rev-parse HEAD
python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('synara-ios/Synara.xcodeproj/project.xcworkspace/xcshareddata/swiftpm/Package.resolved')); print([p for p in d['pins'] if 'matrix-rust' in p['identity']])"
non_goals: No production app code, src-tauri Cargo.toml, package.json, or matrix-js-sdk usage changes
No dual-backend, SDK selector, or raw /_matrix/ HTTP paths
No re-opening of completed P0.2 FR rows 7.8-7.11; no re-promotion of FR-7.9-011
No XCFramework binary committed to the repo; no building XCFramework from source in this task
Alignment is protocol/behavior version strategy, not sharing the same FFI package
